title: 同相比例放大器
statement: 图示为理想运放构成的同相比例放大器，u_s = 2 V，R_1 = 10 kΩ，R_f = 20 kΩ。
求电压放大倍数 u_o/u_s、输出电压 u_o 和 R_1 中的电流 i_1。

questions.explain: u_o = 3 × 2 V = 6 V，与 u_s 同相（同号）。
虚短：u_n = u_{+} = u_s = 2 V，i_1 = u_n/R_1 = 2/10k = 0.2 mA；虚断使这一电流全部来自 R_f。

questions.ask: 从电压源 u_s 看进去，放大器的输入电阻是多少？
choiceExplain: R_1 是反相放大器的输入电阻。同相放大器中 u_s 接在同相端，不经过 R_1，R_1 中的电流来自运放输出端。
R_1、R_f 中的电流从运放输出端经 R_f、R_1 流到地，并不经过 u_s。想一想：u_s 本身输出多大的电流？
questions.explain: u_s 直接接在同相输入端，由“虚断”i_{+} = 0，电源不输出电流，所以输入电阻为无穷大——这是同相放大器相对反相放大器的主要优点。

hints: R_f 把输出接回反相端（负反馈）：先用“虚短”求反相端 n 的电位。
R_1 与 R_f 串联构成对 u_o 的分压器：u_n = u_o·R_1/(R_1 + R_f)。
solution: **1. 负反馈与虚短：** R_f 把输出接回反相端，构成负反馈。由虚短 u_n = u_{−} = u_{+} = u_s = 2 V。
**2. 结点 n 的 KCL：** 由虚断，反相端不取电流，R_1 与 R_f 中是同一个电流：i_1 = u_n/R_1 = 2/10 kΩ = **0.2 mA**。
**4. 放大倍数：** u_o/u_s = 6/2 = **3**，与公式 1 + R_f/R_1 = 1 + 20/10 = 3 一致 ✓。同相放大器的放大倍数总是 ≥ 1，输出与输入同相。

en.title: Non-inverting amplifier
statement: The ideal op-amp forms a non-inverting amplifier with u_s = 2 V, R_1 = 10 kΩ, R_f = 20 kΩ.
Find the voltage gain u_o/u_s, the output voltage u_o and the current i_1 in R_1.

questions.explain: u_o = 3 × 2 V = 6 V, in phase (same sign) with u_s.
Virtual short: u_n = u_{+} = u_s = 2 V, so i_1 = u_n/R_1 = 2/10k = 0.2 mA; by the virtual open this whole current comes through R_f.

questions.ask: What is the input resistance of the amplifier seen by the source u_s?
choiceExplain: R_1 is the input resistance of the inverting amplifier. Here u_s drives the non-inverting input and does not feed R_1; the current in R_1 comes from the op-amp output.
The current in R_f and R_1 flows from the op-amp output through R_f and R_1 to ground; it does not pass through u_s. How much current does u_s itself deliver?
questions.explain: u_s is connected straight to the non-inverting input, which draws no current (virtual open). The source delivers no current, so the input resistance is infinite — the main advantage over the inverting amplifier.

hints: R_f connects the output back to the inverting input (negative feedback): use the virtual short to get the potential of the inverting node n.
R_1 and R_f in series form a voltage divider across u_o: u_n = u_o·R_1/(R_1 + R_f).
solution: **1. Negative feedback and the virtual short:** R_f connects the output back to the inverting input (negative feedback). By the virtual short u_n = u_{−} = u_{+} = u_s = 2 V.
**2. KCL at n:** by the virtual open no current enters the inverting input, so R_1 and R_f carry the same current: i_1 = u_n/R_1 = 2/10 kΩ = **0.2 mA**.
**4. Gain:** u_o/u_s = 6/2 = **3**, which agrees with the formula 1 + R_f/R_1 = 1 + 20/10 = 3 ✓. A non-inverting amplifier's gain is always ≥ 1, with the output in phase with the input.
